name: ExecuTorch GitHub Repository
notes:
ExecuTorch is PyTorch's on-device inference engine. Supports Android, iOS, and Linux embedded targets. Uses .pt2 export format. Provides quantization, delegation to hardware backends (CoreML, NNAPI, QNN, Vulkan).
